doNotShard.description:
If set, no sharding of NormalizedTimeseries tables will be done (neither by data point type nor shardCount)
CAUTION: be very careful about changing this configuration as it can dynamically change the NormalizedTimeseries
table under neath and cause renormalization

shardCount.description:
If set, shards the nts table (after applying byType if set) into the specified number of shards
CAUTION: be very careful about changing this configuration as it can dynamically change the NormalizedTimeseries
table under neath and cause renormalization

title:
Spec specifying how to shard the {@link NormalizedTimeseries} table. By default, NormalizedTimeseries tables will be
sharded by {@link IntervalDataPoint} or {@link TimedDataPoint} type unless {@link doNotShard} is set
name: NormalizedTimeseriesShardSpec
